headlines.title: 财政部将发行特别国债支持8家中央金融企业补充资本
headlines.summary: 财政部将于近期发行3000亿元特别国债，支持8家中央金融企业补充核心一级资本。 当日，工商银行、农业银行、进出口银行、中国信保、中国人保、中国人寿集团、中国太平、中国再保等8家中央金融企业分别发布了增资计划。 业内人士表示，此次财政部对8家中央金融企业增资，属于“未雨绸缪”的前瞻性安排，是支持中央金融企业高质量发展、助力宏观经济行稳致远的主动作为。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Finance Ministry to issue special treasury bonds to support capital replenishment of 8 central financial enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance will soon issue 300 billion yuan in special treasury bonds to support 8 central state-owned financial enterprises in replenishing core Tier-1 capital. On the same day, ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Export-Import Bank of China, Sinosure, PICC, China Life Group, China Taiping, and China Re each announced capital increase plans. Industry insiders said this capital injection by the Ministry of Finance into 8 central financial enterprises is a forward-looking arrangement to 'prepare for rain before it comes,' representing proactive action to support high-quality development of central financial enterprises and steady long-term economic growth. (Xinhua)

headlines.title_en: Finance Ministry to inject 10 billion yuan into China Export & Credit Insurance Corporation
headlines.summary_en: On Sept 6, Sinosure announced that the Ministry of Finance will inject 10 billion yuan into Sinosure. This capital replenishment is being steadily advanced on market-based and law-based principles, fully reflecting the bright prospects of the financial industry. Supporting Sinosure in replenishing core Tier-1 capital helps the company better improve its solvency adequacy ratio, enhance insurer履约 capability, further expand export credit insurance coverage, effectively safeguard long-term financial sustainability, strengthen cash flow resilience of operating activities, and support the company in better fulfilling policy functions and serving the real economy.

headlines.title_en: Agricultural Bank of China plans to raise up to 160 billion yuan to replenish capital; ICBC plans to raise up to 100 billion yuan to replenish capital
headlines.summary_en: On Sept 6, Agricultural Bank of China released its plan to issue A-shares to specific targets on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, proposing to issue A-shares to the Ministry of Finance of the PRC, China National Tobacco Corporation, and related subsidiaries, with total fundraising of no more than 160 billion yuan, all to be used to replenish core Tier-1 capital after deducting related issuance costs. The final fundraising scale is subject to the issuance plan approved by regulatory authorities. On Sept 6, ICBC announced plans to issue A-shares to specific targets—the Ministry of Finance of the PRC, China National Tobacco Corporation, and related subsidiaries—with planned fundraising of no more than 100 billion yuan, all to be used to replenish core Tier-1 capital after deducting related issuance costs. This capital increase will be implemented after completing internal and external approval procedures.

headlines.title: 中国再保计划募资30亿元用于增加核心一级资本
headlines.summary: 9月6日，中国再保董事会审议通过并披露向特定对象发行内资股方案。本次发行拟由财政部以现金方式认购，计划募集资金总额30亿元人民币，在扣除相关发行费用后将全部用于增加中国再保核心一级资本，募集资金规模与最终发行方案以相关监管部门最终批复为准。发行价格为1.33元/股，较中国再保近期H股二级市场价格实现溢价发行，拟发行股份约22.56亿股，发行对象承诺长期持有本次认购股份。

headlines.title_en: China Re plans to raise 3 billion yuan to increase core Tier-1 capital
headlines.summary_en: On Sept 6, China Re's board approved and disclosed a plan to issue domestic shares to specific targets. The issuance will be subscribed in cash by the Ministry of Finance, with planned total fundraising of 3 billion yuan, all to be used to increase China Re's core Tier-1 capital after deducting related issuance costs. The fundraising scale and final issuance plan are subject to final approval by relevant regulatory authorities. The issuance price is 1.33 yuan/share, at a premium to China Re's recent H-share secondary market price, with approximately 2.256 billion shares to be issued, and the subscriber commits to long-term holding of the subscribed shares.

headlines.title: 8月深圳新建商品房成交3467套
headlines.summary: 深圳市房地产中介协会发布最新数据显示，8月份，深圳新建商品房成交3467套，环比下降23.0%，同比增长4.8%；深圳二手住宅录得5108套，环比下降2.3%，同比增长7.6%。今年1-8月，深圳二手房累计录得约4.84万套，同比增长4.7%。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen New Commercial Housing Sales Reach 3,467 Units in August
headlines.summary_en: According to the latest data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Intermediary Association, new commercial housing transactions in Shenzhen totaled 3,467 units in August, down 23.0% month-on-month but up 4.8% year-on-year. Second-hand residential properties recorded 5,108 transactions, down 2.3% month-on-month and up 7.6% year-on-year. From January to August, cumulative second-hand housing transactions in Shenzhen reached approximately 48,400 units, up 4.7% year-on-year.

headlines.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Media High-Level Forum opened in Shenzhen, Guangdong on September 5. Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech. Huang Kunming, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province, attended and delivered remarks. Participants noted that President Xi Jinping's major proposal on building an Asia-Pacific community provides important guidance for jointly fostering an open Asia-Pacific economy and promoting common prosperity. This year is the 'China Year' for APEC, and China will host the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting. It is believed that with support from all parties, the meeting will yield fruitful results and elevate Asia-Pacific cooperation to new heights. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Zhongtai Securities: Mid-to-early September will see fluctuations; still possible to gradually increase positions
headlines.summary_en: Zhongtai Securities noted that it maintains its view that the SSE Composite and STAR 50 will turn stronger again in the medium term, with consolidation in early-to-mid September and room to gradually increase positions. (1) In the medium term, continue to overweight STAR 50, domestic semiconductor equipment, storage, and hard disk sectors, while also watching nonferrous metals and innovative drugs. After US Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations shift, the elasticity of tech manufacturing and nonferrous metals deserves more attention. (2) For liquidity-elasticity directions, watch CSI 2000 and CNI 2000. Resumed Sino-US high-level diplomatic engagement and long-term funds shifting from crash-buying support to sustained inflows will form clearer right-side signals. (3) Balanced and defensive capital should prioritize manufacturing dividend plays such as construction machinery and power equipment. Thematic directions include Hang Seng Tech leaders, on-device AI, and storage demand at the device end. (First Financial)

headlines.title: 三大逻辑推动外资增配 关注中国资产投资新机遇
headlines.summary: 【三大逻辑推动外资增配 关注中国资产投资新机遇】王鹤涛认为，2026年全球资金再平衡背景下，外资持续通过北向资金、QFII等渠道流入A股，中国资产正在从过去的“可选项”，快速迈向全球组合里的“必选项”。外资增配的核心逻辑有三点：一是国内经济具备相对韧性，在全球增长普遍偏弱环境中盈利修复确定性较强；二是A股整体估值对比海外主流市场存在明显折价，同时AI硬件、先进制造拥有独特产业链优势，能提供分散化收益来源；三是资本市场制度型开放持续推进，投资便利性不断提升。

headlines.title_en: Three Factors Drive Foreign Fund Allocation; Focus on New Opportunities in Chinese Assets
headlines.summary_en: 【Three Key Drivers Boost Foreign Allocation, Highlighting New Investment Opportunities in Chinese Assets】Wang Hetao believes that amid global capital rebalancing in 2026, foreign capital continues to flow into A-shares via northbound trading, QFII, and other channels, with Chinese assets rapidly transitioning from 'optional' to 'must-have' in global portfolios. Three core drivers underpin this: first, the domestic economy shows relative resilience, with stronger earnings recovery certainty amid weak global growth; second, A-share valuations remain at a significant discount to major overseas markets, while AI hardware and advanced manufacturing offer unique supply chain advantages that provide diversified return sources; third, the ongoing institutional opening of capital markets is steadily enhancing investment convenience.
